info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Merchandising Loan Application API
info.description: The Merchandising Loan Application API facilitates the submission of loan requests tailored for merchandising needs. This API enables businesses to efficiently apply for loans to finance their inventory or marketing efforts. Typically utilized by retailers and wholesalers, it streamlines the loan application process, allowing users to submit necessary details and documents seamlessly. It is designed to enhance the overall experience of merchants seeking financial support for their operations.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a new merchandising loan application. Provide the necessary details in the request body to create a loan tailored for merchandising purposes, ensuring that all required fields are filled out correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a merchandising loan under the deposit lending category. It includes all necessary information required to process the loan application efficiently.

201.description: The request was successful, and a new resource has been created.
